topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Folks around here, finding an old teddy at a yard sale, they act like they struck gold. Like it’s more than a worn patch of fur and stuffing. It’s just a reminder of times past, not all sunshine and songs. Some go on about the 'memories' it brings back, as if those little pieces of fluff were worth more than the sweat we pour into these fields. I reckon it’s just another way for the lord’s tax collectors to take more coin from us. We’ve got fields to tend, mouths to feed, and a saint’s worth of prayers to say for a decent harvest. No time for old toys.
